name: docs
description: The docs, found and read from inside Vyre: docs.find takes an intent in plain words and returns the best pages with what each is for and what it costs to read; docs.read returns a page, or one section of it, within a token budget. People get the human docs. A session or an agent also gets the agent docs, which are never offered to a person.

tips.text: Ask the docs in plain words: `vyre call docs.find '{"query":"how do I back up the server"}'` returns the best pages.
Read one section, not a whole page: `docs.read` takes a heading and returns only that part, so it costs less.
New to how Vyre is built? The map is a 30-minute read: kernel, modules, the Gate, the Vault, apps.
